critical_code_review_comments: ASEForm.jsx is now 1144+ lines (>700-line guideline). The fetchJobAndASE auto-populate logic (lines 433-687) should be extracted to a dedicated hook (e.g. useASEAutoPopulate) and the tabs split into separate components.

fetchJobAndASE intentionally only auto-fills when target field is empty (correct), but has a subtle bug at line 659: nteItem = ugData.find(i => i.type === 'NTE' || (i.type === 'FBT/NTE' && fbtItem?.id !== i.id)). The OR short-circuits on plain 'NTE' so the FBT/NTE same-id check never triggers for a single FBT/NTE marker. If only one FBT/NTE marker exists, fbtItem and nteItem are the same object, and distance calculation returns 0 (handled by `if (dist > 0)`), but conceptually misleading. Consider explicit handling for co-located FBT/NTE.

Pole.span_distance values are parsed with parseFloat (good) but unit suffix is hard-coded as 'ft' regardless of stored unit. If span_distance is ever stored in meters, the tie-in measurements string becomes incorrect.

proposed_pole_and_bldg uses pole_number which can be 'EXPORT-TEST' (seed test data) - rendered output is 'Poles: 1, EXPORT-TEST'. Fine functionally, but worth confirming the format with PM (e.g., whether building info should be appended).
calculateDistance is defined inside the component on every render - move outside the component or memoize.

Auto-populate runs once on mount via useEffect+useCallback dep on jobId only; if user adds/edits a pole or underground item in another tab, the ASE form won't refresh until reload. Consider a manual 'Re-pull from job data' button or websocket invalidation.
